subject: Post-discovery: propose 30m preview & calendar handshake
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janet Simmons <janet.simmons@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose 30m preview & calendar handshake

Hi Janet — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goals: reduce per-token inference cost for batch pipelines and tighten 95th-percentile latency for customer-facing conversational flows.
- Current constraints: multi-region compliance (EU), OpenTelemetry traces required, and limited infra ops bandwidth for a pilot.

We recommend a short 30-minute product preview (no deep engineering setup) to show: inference latency profiles, batching/caching options, and the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for your compliance needs.

Can you confirm a 30-minute slot next week? Three options that work for our team (all PT):
- Option A: Wed 10/11 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thu 10/12 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Option C: Fri 10/13 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Suggested Redwood attendees: myself (product), Neha (solutions engineer), Priyom (technical enablement). If there are internal stakeholders you want present (infra/product/security), let me know which two we should prioritize and we’ll adjust.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (short summary) and a first-pass mutual-action-plan docx to speed the procurement convo.

Next steps: pick the best option and we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (15 minutes demo + 15 minutes Q&A).

Thanks — look forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- discovery-notes.pdf (1 page)
- mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (outline)
From: Janet Simmons <janet.simmons@aperturehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose 30m preview & calendar handshake

Thanks, David — that recap is helpful. Appreciate the three options. Quick notes from our side:

- We definitely want our Product lead (Marcus) and one infra engineer on the call. Marcus is cc'd.
- We have standing leadership reviews on Wed mornings, so Option A will be tricky.
- Option C conflicts with an internal all-hands in some groups.

Two times that work best for us (ET):
- Wed 10/11 — 1:00–1:30 PM ET (which is your 10:00–10:30 AM PT) — possible if we can keep it tight.
- Thu 10/12 — 5:00–5:30 PM ET (your 2:00–2:30 PM PT) — Marcus prefers this window.

If you can lock one of those and include an agenda item on security/compliance (very brief), we’ll send the calendar.

Also, can you confirm whether the demo will touch on our multi-region routing options and audit log retention? Those are procurement gating items.

Janet Simmons
Director of Product
Aperture Health

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janet Simmons <janet.simmons@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@aperturehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose 30m preview & calendar handshake

Janet — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and for looping in Marcus.

We can confirm Thu 10/12 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (5:00–5:30 PM ET). That aligns with Marcus's preference and avoids your Wed leadership block.

Agenda (short):
1) 10 min — Product preview focused on latency and batching profiles (what you'll see in the console)
2) 10 min — Security/compliance touchpoints (multi-region routing, audit logs, KMS integration) — Neha to lead
3) 10 min — Next steps & MAP alignment (Priyom to run through recommended pilot scope)

I’ve attached an updated mutual-action-plan-draft.docx with proposed owners for the pilot. Specific asks for your team ahead of the call:
- If Marcus can share his top 2 success metrics (latency targets / cost targets) that helps us tailor the brief.
- If your infra engineer will need pre-read (e.g., network IP allowlist), let me know and we’ll include docs.

I’ll send the calendar invite with the above agenda and include the short pre-read link to the docs.

Thanks — see you Thu.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (updated owners)

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2781
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janet Simmons <janet.simmons@aperturehealth.com>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@aperturehealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose 30m preview & calendar handshake

Thanks all — confirming Thu 10/12 at 2:00 PM PT (5:00 PM ET) works for our side. I’ll create the calendar invite and share a short pre-read (IP ranges + audit-log sample) in the event details.

Quick note on attendees from Redwood:
- David Kim (product)
- Neha Kapoor (solutions)
- Priyom Das (technical enablement)

Janet / Marcus — if you want any additional infra detail included in the pre-read, tell me and I’ll add it. Otherwise I’ll send the invite shortly.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
